title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover a range of study environments across the Carroll College campus, from 24/7 fireside lounges to quiet chapels and modern learning commons.

cards.title: Fireside Room
cards.subtitle: Corette Library & Simperman Learning Commons
cards.notes: Access this 24/7 study space for late-night sessions. It features comfortable seating and a fireplace, providing a warm atmosphere for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 study lounge located within the Corette Library complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corette Library offers a range of study spaces, including individual study rooms and the 24/7 Fireside Room.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for Carroll College students with card access.

cards.title: The Sandbox
cards.subtitle: Simperman Learning Commons
cards.notes: Utilize this flexible classroom and meeting space equipped with five projectors and whiteboard walls for collaborative group projects.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech collaborative space with whiteboard walls and multiple projectors.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 208 (Sandbox) is a classroom or meeting room with 36 seats, 5 projectors, and whiteboard walls.
cards.access_notes: Available for study sessions when not in use by classes; students can request reservations.

cards.title: St. Charles Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: St. Charles Hall
cards.notes: Study in the campus's oldest building, featuring a large lounge with booths, a mock fireplace, and views of the surrounding mountains.
cards.short_summary: A historic lounge area with booths and mountain views in St. Charles Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Charles Hall features a huge lounge area including couches, chairs, booths, and a mock fireplace.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents, but contains designated classroom and study spaces throughout the building.

cards.title: Trinity Lounge
cards.subtitle: Trinity Hall
cards.notes: Find a spot in this large community lounge equipped with tables, chairs, and a big-screen TV, ideal for both solo and group study.
cards.short_summary: A spacious community lounge in Trinity Hall used for study and small gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Trinity Hall has a huge lounge area including couches, chairs, tables, and a big-screen TV.
cards.access_notes: Located near the building's front desk; accessible to students for study and meetings.

cards.title: The Scola
cards.subtitle: Fortin Science Center
cards.notes: Use this open commons area for casual study or attending panel discussions in a U-shaped space designed for student interaction.
cards.short_summary: A commons area in the science center used for study and academic events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Scola commons area located in the Fortin Science Center is a great space for gatherings or meetings.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours for student use.

cards.title: All Saints Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry Hub
cards.notes: Seek out this quiet, reverent space for personal reflection and silent study away from the busier campus hubs.
cards.short_summary: A quiet chapel providing areas for personal reflection and prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: All Saints Chapel provides areas that promote personal reflection, prayer and growth.
cards.access_notes: Open to the college community for worship and quiet reflection.

cards.title: Borromeo Basement Lounge
cards.subtitle: Borromeo Hall
cards.notes: Take advantage of the desks and beanbags in this basement lounge, known for being part of one of the quietest residence halls on campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet basement study area with desks and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Borromeo Hall has a basement lounge area complete with desks, couches, chairs, and beanbags.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students; Borromeo is noted for its tranquil atmosphere.

cards.title: HAC Study Area
cards.subtitle: Hunthausen Activity Center
cards.notes: Find a small, quiet study spot on the far side of the activity center, perfect for a quick session between workouts.
cards.short_summary: A small study area located within the campus fitness and activity center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hunthausen Activity Center includes a small study area on the far side of the building.
cards.source_title: Carroll College Hunthausen Activity Center - Dick Anderson Construction

cards.title: Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Corette Library
cards.notes: Claim one of these non-reservable rooms for maximum privacy. They are available on a first-come, first-served basis for focused individual work.
cards.short_summary: Private, non-reservable rooms for individual study in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Individual study rooms are not reservable for students or faculty and are available for use.
cards.access_notes: Available during library open hours; first-come, first-served.

cards.title: The Cube
cards.subtitle: Campus Center
cards.notes: Choose from round, square, or high-top tables in this casual space, ideal for studying in a more social, active environment.
cards.short_summary: A casual study and event space with various seating options in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Upper Campus Center (The Cube) features four-person tables ranging from rounds to squares to high tops.
cards.access_notes: Open for student use when not reserved for events.
